context: Tests whether the agent copies a sibling field, follows the Sling Model, HTL and clientlib conventions, does the wiring outside the component folder, and reports honestly.

checklist.name: Copies a sibling
checklist.description: Reads `textinput` (or another simple field) and follows its structure rather than inventing one

checklist.name: Sling Model conventions
checklist.description: Interface plus impl; `@Model` adapters list the interface and `ComponentExporter`; `resourceType` uses the `FormConstants` constant; optional properties use `InjectionStrategy.OPTIONAL`; a `FormConstants` entry exists

checklist.name: Clientlib category and base
checklist.description: Site clientlib category is `core.forms.components.urlinput.v1.runtime` and it depends on `core.forms.components.runtime.base` with `allowProxy` true

checklist.name: View JS registration
checklist.description: View JS extends `FormView.FormFieldBase` and registers with `FormView.Utils.setupField`

checklist.name: HTL root attributes
checklist.description: Root `div` has `data-cmp-is`, the state attributes, `data-cmp-data-layer` and `id="${component.id}"`; the widget id is the component id plus `-widget`

checklist.name: pom.xml replace line
checklist.description: `ui.af.apps/pom.xml` gains a `<replace>` line for `urlinput` with token `.core-adaptiveform`

checklist.name: Runtime embed
checklist.description: The `urlinput` site clientlib category is added to the `embed` list of `core-forms-components-runtime-all`

checklist.name: Tests and docs
checklist.description: Unit test with test content, component README, and an example proxy or page are added

checklist.name: Static validator run
checklist.description: Runs `validate-component.mjs urlinput --root .` and fixes every FAIL

checklist.name: Honest report
checklist.description: `REPORT.md` names gates that could not run (Maven, Cypress, AEM) with the exact command, and does not claim they passed
